authorship.method: Hand-authored from the frozen approved bank before consulting fastText/E5 outputs, phonemizer outputs or generated rankings.
authorship.status: Frozen semantic expectations and technical pronunciation probes; no human preferences collected.

policy.semanticEvaluation: Strict cosine ordering on unfiltered semantic scores; picture collisions are independent validity constraints, not negative semantic labels.
policy.ties: Report separately; ties do not satisfy strict orderings. Item-ID tie breaking is for deterministic lists, never benchmark wins.
policy.queries: ExpectedUsefulIds are selected examples, not exhaustive gold neighborhoods. Report recall at five on these known positives; report picture-filtered results separately with excluded-positive counts.
policy.unsupported: Keep unsupported items/probes visible in the declared denominator; fail incomplete bank preparation rather than silently skipping words.
policy.phonetics: Same-pronunciation expectations apply only to the stated canonical dialect policy. Normalization checks and exact-key tests are correctness diagnostics, not acoustic-confusability or learner-difficulty labels.
policy.independence: English labels inform intended-sense expectations and E5 input; neither benchmark nor model scores are independent human judgments.

design.targetSelection: Eight primary targets fixed before rankings; four separately declared optional inspection targets are outside primary result counts. No replacements chosen after seeing model output.
design.blinding: Hide method names, numeric scores, meanings and spelling before initial response. Balance A/B assignment across the four regional passes for each target using a recorded deterministic order; candidate order must not disclose rank.
design.promptPronunciation: Which group sounds more similar to the target while remaining distinguishable?
design.promptSemantic: Which group contains words closer in meaning while still giving unambiguous alternative pictures?
design.missing: Null means pending. Omit identical candidate sets with explicit unchanged counts; preserve insufficient-candidate and unavailable-audio reasons without backfilling different targets.
design.scope: Use approved ordinary picture candidates only, enforcing language, selected pack, duplicate-image and pairwise picture exclusions. Nine direct foundation contexts remain out of this pool.
design.analysis: Report semantic and pronunciation judgments separately, split by region and reveal status. Repeated targets/voices from one owner are dependent observations; no significance or learning-benefit claim.
